title: B(10, 0.2): at most one success
caption: P(X = 2) = 0.302 and P(X ≤ 1) = 0.1074 + 0.2684 = 0.3758: the two shaded bars at 0 and 1.
alt: Bar chart of the binomial distribution B(10, 0.2); the bars at 0 and 1 are shaded, total 0.3758.
description: The bars give P(X = k) for k = 0 to 10; the mean is 2 and the tallest bars are at 1 and 2.
The shaded bars at 0 and 1 add to 0.3758 = P(X ≤ 1).
